steelTriggerFixture.interpretation: The controlled source fixture triggers Mole excavation with a steel-tagged object. The decoded tag combines the runtime's solid bit 0x20 and steel bit 0x40. This establishes the material in this witness, but not whether other materials also trigger Mole excavation.

runtimeGap.observedRuntimeBehavior: The Mole treats the 0x40 steel bit as a protected boundary. It can start a diagonal state at that boundary, but it does not clear steel. Its vertical movement and terrain edits use the current provisional rule.
runtimeGap.fixtureBehavior: The retained source fixture places left-facing Mole object 10013 at (152,92) and steel cells with tag 0x60 at x=112...119, y=96...111. The source trace reports steel contact and first down-right motion at tick 36.
runtimeGap.interpretation: The runtime recognises steel as a protected boundary, but this alone does not prove source-equivalent contact or excavation. Its trace matches 141/329 source positions. The source tunnel-edge witnesses still do not establish the full excavation mask.

closureEffect: The refreshed level-113 fixture hashes close six stale expected-state mismatches.
